editorial: While ambitious proof studies on the Riemann Hypothesis are coming to the fore in the world of mathematics today, specialized artificial intelligence models and security-focused action algorithms are drawing attention on the software side. Next-generation models like Inkling-2-Mini, shared on GitHub and Hugging Face platforms, focus on improving system architectures with local causality discovery and safe stop capabilities.

items.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
items.summary: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter is a Claude Code capability package designed for bug hunting and external security testing (red-teaming) processes. It contains 82 different capabilities, 15 commands, and hundreds of reporting templates categorized into 24 basic vulnerability classes.

snapshot.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: obra/superpowers is a capability framework and software development methodology developed for AI coding agents. It aims to help agents manage software processes more efficiently through composable skills and core instructions.

snapshot.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works. Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.

items.title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
items.summary: CLI-Anything is a command-line interface (CLI) tool that makes various software suitable for use by AI agents. This tool aims to transform software into an agent-native structure for different AI-powered development environments such as Pi, OpenClaw, nanobot, Cursor, and Claude Code.

snapshot.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: One Command Line: Make any software agent-ready for Pi, OpenClaw, nanobot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc. 中文文档 | 日本語ドキュメント | Deutsch

items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.summary: jingyaogong/minimind is a project that allows you to train a 64M parameter large language model (LLM) from scratch on personal devices within two hours. It offers a small-scale infrastructure ready to be trained so that users can deeply understand the working mechanisms of artificial intelligence models.

snapshot.description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours. 大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的出现，引发了全球范围内对 AI 的空前关注。无论是 ChatGPT、DeepSeek 还是 Qwen，都以惊艳的效果让人真切感受到这场技术浪潮的冲击力。然而，动辄数百亿参数的模型规模，使得它们对个人设备而言不仅难以训练，甚至连部署都显得遥不可及。打开大模型的“黑盒子”，真正去理解其内部运作机制，本应是一件令人心潮澎湃的事。遗憾的是，绝大多数探索最终都止步于使用 LoRA 等技术对现有大模型做少量微调，学习一些新指令或特定任务。这更像是在教牛顿如何使用 21 世纪的智能手机——虽然有趣，却偏离了理解物理本质的初衷。

items.title: cursor/plugins
items.summary: Cursor offers a repository containing the technical standards and official extensions for the plugins developed for the code editor Cursor. Prepared in the TypeScript language, this resource includes plugin specifications that allow users to customize their development environments.

snapshot.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins

items.title: firecrawl/firecrawl
items.summary: Firecrawl is an information infrastructure that collects data from over 550 providers to facilitate data access for AI agents. By offering search and scraping operations through a single application programming interface (API), it provides developers with tools and software development kits (SDKs) that they can host on their own servers.

snapshot.description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API. Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. 🔥 You can use Firecrawl three ways. This repo holds the code for Firecrawl Local and the self-hosted server, along with SDKs that work with all three.

items.title: nginx/nginx
items.summary: NGINX is an open-source software used as a web server, load balancer, reverse proxy, API gateway, and content cache. Developed in the C language, this popular project is preferred for managing network traffic and increasing the performance of web applications.

snapshot.description: The official NGINX Open Source repository. NGINX (pronounced "engine x" or "en-jin-eks") is the world's most popular Web Server, high performance Load Balancer, Reverse Proxy, API Gateway and Content Cache.

items.title: openvinotoolkit/openvino
items.summary: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit used to optimize and deploy the inference processes of artificial intelligence models. Developed in the C++ language, this platform enables models to run more efficiently on different hardware.

snapshot.description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference. Check out the OpenVINO Cheat Sheet and Key Features for a quick reference.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.summary: Cathrynlavery/diagram-design offers 45 different types of editorial diagram designs prepared for AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. The project brings together visualization options in HTML and SVG formats that are shadow-free and have no external dependencies.

snapshot.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary: mvanhorn/last30days-skill offers an AI skill that summarizes topics by conducting research on Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the general web. Developed in the Python language, this tool aims to create a grounded summary by synthesizing data collected from different platforms.

snapshot.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
items.summary: Developed by Google, stitch-skills is an agent skills library designed to work compatibly with the Stitch MCP server. This library follows open capability standards to be used with software such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and the code editor Cursor.

snapshot.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

items.title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance
items.summary: mjmirza/app-store-compliance is an open-source guide containing 117 different patterns and solutions to prevent app store rejection reasons. This tool, which enables software developers to manage legal compliance processes, also offers support for AI coding agents.

snapshot.description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 117 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 95 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.

items.title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre
items.summary: Tracer-Cloud/opensre is an open-source AI agent developed to increase the reliability of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes. This tool, which ensures that software updates are automatically tested and deployed, offers a structure that does not require administrator privileges during installation.

snapshot.description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability. The installer fetches the latest build from main without requiring sudo. If opensre is not found, follow the PATH instructions printed by the installer or open a new terminal.

items.title: toeverything/AFFiNE
items.summary: AFFiNE is a next-generation knowledge base that combines planning, editing, and content creation processes into a single platform. This privacy-focused and open-source (source code is open for everyone to access and develop) software offers a workspace as an alternative to tools like Notion and Miro.

snapshot.description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.

items.title: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3
items.summary: Developed with Python, Ghost-Downloader-3 is a comprehensive file downloading tool that runs on different platforms and supports various download protocols. Originally designed for a content creator's resource management needs, the project now offers an extensible structure with a plugin-based feature packs ecosystem.

snapshot.description: The only downloader you need. 下载器的集大成者。. Started as a passion project to help a Bilibili creator manage resources. Now it ships on four platforms, handles virtually every download protocol, and has a growing Feature Packs plugin ecosystem.

items.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
items.summary: zhouxiaoka/autoclip is an open-source desktop video editing tool that automatically converts long videos into short clips. The software prepares content such as podcasts and interviews for social media platforms with subtitles, cover images, and description text.

snapshot.description: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.

items.title: Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary: Developed by Thinking Machines, Inkling 2 Mini is an open-weights AI model small enough to run on laptops. The model loops its middle layers to perform more reasoning on each token and reaches its responses using fewer tokens.

snapshot.description: Inkling 2 Mini is an open-weights model small enough to run on your laptop. It loops its middle layers to reason more per token and reach answers in fewer tokens.

Supported by Lean FRO and the Mathlib Initiative, this work focuses on the process of verifying mathematical proofs in a computer environment.

items.title: Slopstrap – Make your site look hastily vibecoded
items.summary: Slopstrap is a style template (CSS framework) that aims to make websites look as if they were created by artificial intelligence models (LLMs). It is positioned as an accelerator developed to give designs a fast and sloppy aesthetic.

snapshot.description: It's not just a CSS framework — it's a load-bearing accelerant to make anything look like it was made by an LLM.

items.title: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini
items.summary: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini, shared on Hugging Face, is a multimodal AI model that processes text and image inputs to produce text output. It is designed for general-purpose use in various programming languages as well as English and other languages.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Inkling 2 Mini is a general-purpose multimodal model that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is intended for use in English and other languages, and across multiple coding languages.

items.title: unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF
items.summary: unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF, shared on Hugging Face, is an AI model that processes visual and text inputs to produce text output. The 4-bit version of the model can be run via the 3D modeling tool Blender and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. See an example of 4-bit Inkling Mini running in Unsloth in Blender + MCP:

items.title: tencent/Hy4-flash
items.summary: Developed by Tencent, Hunyuan-flash is an image-text-to-text model capable of processing text and image inputs. Offering a context window support of up to 1 million tokens, the model aims for cost-effective performance with 12 billion active parameters.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Hy4 flash is our most cost-effective Hy model to date, featuring 220B total parameters (including 64B Engram parameters) with just 12B active parameters per token. It natively accepts text and image inputs, generates text, and supports a context window of up to 1M tokens.

items.title: inworld/voice-isolator
items.summary: Inworld Voice Isolator v1 presents an artificial intelligence architecture consisting of two different models that process audio input to provide output (audio-to-audio). Shared on Hugging Face, these models aim to optimize voice isolation processes.

snapshot.description: audio-to-audio model. Inworld Voice Isolator v1 ships as two models that share one architecture:

items.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
items.summary: Developed by Lightricks, LTX-2.5 is an artificial intelligence model that converts images into moving videos (image-to-video model). Shared on the Hugging Face platform, this tool focuses on the processes of generating video from static content.

snapshot.description: image-to-video model

items.title: Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face introduces the Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery (ITPD) method to improve causal discovery processes in time series data. This method offers a constraint-based procedure to overcome statistical challenges such as autocorrelation and the curse of dimensionality in time series.

snapshot.description: Learning and inference on time series can pose significant statistical challenges, including autocorrelated observations, distribution shift over time, and the curse of dimensionality. These challenges complicate the practical application of causal discovery algorithms, which already suffer from high computational and sample complexity in the general case. To mitigate these issues, this work introduces Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery (ITPD): a sound and complete constraint-based procedure fo

items.title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
items.summary: Vision-language-action models enable robots to perform tasks using visual data and language commands. Researchers are developing new methods to ensure these models can safely stop ongoing prohibited or erroneous physical actions.

snapshot.description: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform diverse tasks from visual observations and language instructions. While prior work has explored task suppression and refusal, stopping prohibited behavior once execution is underway and controlling the resulting physical response remain challenging. Our evaluation reveals that policies which suppress a task from its initial state can still complete it when taking over partway through execution. Even when the task remains unfinished, th

items.title: PAD: Policy-Aware Data Valuation for Autonomous Driving
items.summary: Developed to determine the value of data used in autonomous driving systems, PAD: Policy-Aware Data Valuation for Autonomous Driving aims to measure the impact of data on end-to-end planners. Unlike existing data selection techniques, this method helps filter out unnecessary or harmful samples by evaluating the value of data directly based on policy utility.

snapshot.description: End-to-end autonomous driving increasingly depends on scaling training demonstrations, yet data growth does not guarantee proportional gains. However, additional data do not guarantee better policies: a demonstration that benefits one planner may be redundant or harmful to another. Existing curation methods typically infer data value from intrinsic sample properties or training-dependent proxies that do not measure downstream policy utility. items.title: Lang-SVG: Hierarchical Image Vectorization with Language Priors
items.summary: Lang-SVG creates a hierarchical structure by using language priors while converting raster images into editable scalable vector graphics (SVG). This method allows vector graphics to be managed more easily in a way that aligns with human perception by organizing visual elements in a semantic tree structure.

snapshot.description: Image vectorization reconstructs raster images as compact scalable vector graph- ics (SVG), providing a structured and editable code representation of images. However, most existing vectorization methods optimize for pixel-level render- ing fidelity, often producing SVGs that lack alignment with human-perceived object-part hierarchies, making them difficult to manipulate. items.title: Squoosh Bench: Evaluating UX-1 on 318 Historical Website A/B Tests
items.summary: Squoosh Bench evaluates the UX-1 model, developed to predict the performance of website changes, across 318 different A/B tests. The study examines how artificial intelligence models fine-tuned with human browsing data can be used in decision-making processes before live traffic.

snapshot.description: Experimentation teams must decide which proposed website changes to test with live traffic. We evaluated whether forecasts from simulated shoppers could inform that choice. We screened 412 historical website A/B tests and evaluated four systems on the 318 that ran longer than 21 days. Each system predicted an original win, a variant win, or an inconclusive result. glossary.explanation: A systematic search process conducted to find bugs and security vulnerabilities within software.
A security audit that simulates malicious attacks to test the security of a system.
A working environment that provides ready-made building blocks, ensuring a specific order and standard while developing software.
Modular capabilities that can be added to each other or combined and used for different tasks.
A text-based interface that allows you to manage programs by typing written commands instead of using a mouse.
A structure designed directly for the use of AI agents, fully compatible with their way of working.
AI models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
A set of technical rules and standards that determine how software or a plugin should function.
The process of automatically copying and extracting data from websites.
A connection bridge that allows different software to exchange data with each other.
Tools and code libraries that make it easier for developers to build applications for a specific platform or service.
A tool that prevents system overload by distributing incoming internet traffic across multiple servers.
An intermediary system that handles requests from the internet, forwards them to the appropriate server, and hides the server's identity.
A type of software where the source code is open for anyone to inspect, modify, and improve.
The process of a trained AI model making predictions or performing analysis on new data.
A specialized function or capability used by AI agents to perform a specific task.
